metadata.warning: Reported-data view. Only source systems already integrated are shown. Missing edges mean not yet integrated, not zero. Current graph includes BLS QCEW covered wages; additional BEA, Fed, SEC, Census, FEC, Treasury and USAspending flows are being added source by source.

Federal, state, and local QCEW wages combined: $307.040B federal + $411.180B state + $1,008.815B local.
